description: Permanently delete one file from the media library. Takes the file ID from get_media_library ONLY — never guess it. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT BEFORE CALLING, naming the file: the image is destroyed and there is NO UNDO. Tell them this too, because the platform does not check it and nothing is cleaned up afterwards: if any product or category uses this image, it KEEPS the dead URL and its picture turns into a broken image — the file is not detached, it is only made unreachable. There is no reverse lookup here from a file to the products using it, so if they are unsure, say so and let them check on the Media screen in the cabinet rather than deleting on a guess. The file may also stay listed on that screen afterwards, because that screen is fed by a separate service. Removing a photo from ONE product without destroying the file is not this tool — that is a product edit.

fileId.description: File id from get_media_library — not a name or a URL
